function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the identity of the customer before discussing any account details or debt.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer.

verification_code.description: The verification code provided by the customer.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs a Promise-to-Pay (PTP) commitment from the customer.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer.

ptp_date.description: The date the customer promised to pay in ISO-8601 format.

amount.description: The amount the customer has promised to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link to the customer.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment link should be sent.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the call to a human agent or resolution desk.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer.

reason.description: The reason for escalating to a human agent.

notes.description: Optional notes or details regarding the escalation.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the outcome or final status of the call.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer.

status.description: The outcome disposition status of the call.

notes.description: Optional notes or details regarding the disposition.
